packages.name: @role-model-router/foldkit
packages.mapping: published `./dist/<rel>.js` import target -> `src/<rel>.ts`; root `.` -> `src/index.ts`; every mapped file is checked for existence by exact name (readdir, no case folding) and a missing one throws.
packages.nonRootTypesShims: tsc emits dist/types/<source-rel>.d.ts; build.mjs writes dist/types/<key>.d.ts re-export shims for subpath exports that do not already match a source-relative path (e.g. model-preservation, devtools-protocol, experimental/machine).

packages.name: @role-model-router/foldkit-ui
packages.mapping: same derivation as the foldkit wrapper (published ./dist/<rel>.js -> src/<rel>.ts).
packages.peerRewrite: esbuild onResolve rewrites `foldkit` and `foldkit/<subpath>` to `@role-model-router/foldkit` / `@role-model-router/foldkit/<subpath>` and keeps them external, so the UI graph has one shared framework instance and never bundles foldkit.

graphEvidence.scannerNote: The test masks strings, templates and comments before extracting import statements. This matters: the built foldkit runtime embeds warning text containing `import { foldkit } from '@foldkit/vite-plugin'`, which a naive raw scan reports as a false-positive import. The masked scanner reports no vite-plugin specifier; a temporary raw-scan run flagged that string, which is how the masking was found to be necessary.
